acceptance_criteria.criterion: APICacheException exists with ERROR_EMPTY_USER_CACHE_IDENTIFIER, ERROR_INVALID_METHOD_NAME, ERROR_CACHE_FILE_CORRUPT constants and extends Application\API\APIException
APICacheManager::getMethodCacheFolder() throws APICacheException for empty string, strings with /, .., or DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR
CacheableAPIMethodTrait::readFromCache() returns null and deletes the file when cache contains invalid JSON
CacheableAPIMethodTrait::getCacheKey() uses json_encode($params, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) instead of serialize()
composer analyze reports no new errors

summary: Created APICacheException (src/classes/Application/API/Cache/APICacheException.php) extending APIException with three error code constants: ERROR_EMPTY_USER_CACHE_IDENTIFIER (59213009), ERROR_INVALID_METHOD_NAME (59213010), ERROR_CACHE_FILE_CORRUPT (59213011).
Added input validation guard to APICacheManager::getMethodCacheFolder() — throws APICacheException::ERROR_INVALID_METHOD_NAME for empty string, strings containing '/', '..', or DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR.
Added corrupt-cache resilience to CacheableAPIMethodTrait::readFromCache() — wraps $cacheFile->parse() in try-catch(\Throwable), deletes the file best-effort, returns null on parse failure.
Changed CacheableAPIMethodTrait::getCacheKey() from serialize($params) to json_encode($params, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR).
Added @phpstan-require-implements CacheableAPIMethodInterface to CacheableAPIMethodTrait class docblock.
ran composer dump-autoload — succeeded.
ran composer analyze — 7 pre-existing errors in deprecated/test files; no errors in modified files.

comments.note: APICacheManager::invalidateMethod() now implicitly propagates APICacheException from getMethodCacheFolder() but has no @throws annotation updated. PHPStan did not flag this since invalidateMethod() always passes a framework-controlled method name, so the guard only fires on misuse. Consider adding @throws to the docblock for completeness.

The inline catch in readFromCache() (try { $cacheFile->delete(); } catch(\Throwable $ignored) {}) is intentionally compact. If similar best-effort delete patterns appear elsewhere, a private helper (e.g. tryDelete(JSONFile)) would centralize the pattern.

summary: All 7 acceptance criteria verified by code inspection and test execution.
APICacheException: class exists at src/classes/Application/API/Cache/APICacheException.php, extends APIException, declares all 3 error code constants (59213009–59213011) with strict_types=1.

APICacheManager::getMethodCacheFolder(): guard checks empty string, '/', '..', and DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR — all 4 conditions throw APICacheException::ERROR_INVALID_METHOD_NAME with descriptive developer info. Constructor call uses 3-arg signature compatible with Application_Exception parent.

CacheableAPIMethodTrait::readFromCache(): try-catch(\Throwable) wraps $cacheFile->parse(); on exception the file is deleted best-effort (inner try-catch ignores deletion failures) and null is returned.
CacheableAPIMethodTrait::getCacheKey(): uses json_encode($params, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) — serialize() is gone.
@phpstan-require-implements CacheableAPIMethodInterface present in CacheableAPIMethodTrait class docblock.

Regression: 13/13 APICacheStrategyTest assertions pass; 6/6 APICacheIntegrationTest assertions pass (including invalidateMethod no-op path, which still passes because 'NonExistentMethod' clears all 4 validation checks).

PHPStan: 7 errors total — all pre-existing, located in Countries/Admin/Traits, DBHelper, UI/PropertiesGrid, _deprecated/Screens/Submode.php, frame.footer.php template, and DisposingTest.php. Zero errors in any WP-001 file.

comments.note: No test coverage exists for the 3 newly-hardened behaviours: (1) APICacheException thrown on invalid method names, (2) corrupt-cache null-return path in readFromCache(), (3) json_encode exception on non-encodable params. The WP AC did not require new tests, so this is not a FAIL, but unit tests for these paths would close observable coverage gaps for future WPs.

On POSIX systems (macOS/Linux) DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR equals '/', making the str_contains($methodName, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) check redundant with the str_contains($methodName, '/') check. The redundancy is harmless and aids Windows portability — no action needed.

summary: WP-001 reviewed across all four dimensions (maintainability, best practices, security, future context). All five requirements (R1–R5) are implemented correctly. No blocking issues found.
APICacheException is well-structured — typed constants, strict_types=1, correct inheritance chain.
APICacheManager guard covers all four traversal vectors (empty string, '/', '..', DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR). Docblock correctly documents that $methodName must be framework-internal.
CacheableAPIMethodTrait: json_encode(JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) correctly replaces serialize(), ksort() ensures deterministic keys, @phpstan-require-implements is properly placed.
Three low-priority style/observability items noted (see comments) — none block progression.

comments.note: APICacheException::ERROR_CACHE_FILE_CORRUPT (59213011) is dead code — defined as 'reserved for logging context' but never referenced in production code. The corrupt-cache resilience path in readFromCache() silently deletes and returns null with no log entry. A future WP adding observability should wire this constant into a logger call so operators can detect systematic cache corruption.

CacheableAPIMethodTrait::readFromCache(): the inner catch is written as 'catch(\Throwable $ignored) {}' but since the project targets PHP 8.4+, the idiomatic form (PHP 8.0+) is 'catch(\Throwable) {}' with no variable binding. The current form creates an unused variable that some static analysers flag. Non-blocking style point.

APICacheManager::invalidateMethod() propagates APICacheException from getMethodCacheFolder() but has no @throws annotation in its docblock. While the exception cannot fire from legitimate framework-internal callers (getMethodName() always returns clean values), the API contract is incomplete. A @throws APICacheException annotation would make it self-documenting for callers who invoke invalidateMethod() directly.

summary: Updated src/classes/Application/API/Cache/README.md to reflect WP-001 and WP-003 changes: rewrote Error Handling section (corrupt-cache resilience is now transparent — no exception propagates, file auto-deleted; old text incorrectly said JSONConverterException would propagate), updated Cache Key Generation to show json_encode instead of serialize, updated Cache Strategies table to show STRATEGY_ID constants and filemtime() false guard, added new APICacheException section documenting the three error constants and the getMethodCacheFolder() path-traversal guard.

Updated src/classes/Application/API/Cache/module-context.yaml: updated description to mention APICacheException, STRATEGY_ID constants, and corrupt-file resilience; corrected readFromCache keyword (no longer propagates JSONConverterException); added getMethodCacheFolder keyword with APICacheException guard detail; added APICacheException keyword with all three constants; added APICacheException.php to the architecture-core document source description; updated FixedDurationStrategy and ManualOnlyStrategy keywords to include STRATEGY_ID values and filemtime(false) behavior.

comments.note: The README Classes table does not yet list APICacheException as a class entry. It was added as a standalone section instead. A future doc pass could add it to the table for completeness, alongside a note that it is only thrown for framework misuse scenarios.

notes: WP-001 introduces APICacheException in the Application\API\Cache namespace — no use-import needed in APICacheManager.php (same namespace). WP-002 and any further WPs using APICacheException can reference it directly within the same namespace.

The 7 pre-existing PHPStan errors are in _deprecated/Screens/Submode.php, src/themes/default/templates/frame.footer.php, and tests/AppFrameworkTests/DBHelper/DisposingTest.php — these are not part of this project scope.

WP-001 is fully verified: APICacheException (3 constants, extends APIException), getMethodCacheFolder() path-traversal guard, readFromCache() corrupt-cache resilience, getCacheKey() json_encode, and @phpstan-require-implements docblock — all confirmed by source inspection + 19 passing tests.

Pre-existing PHPStan errors (7 total) are confined to Countries/Admin/Traits, DBHelper, UI/PropertiesGrid, _deprecated/Screens/Submode.php, frame.footer.php, and DisposingTest.php — none in WP-001 scope.
No new test files were written for the hardened behaviours. Code-review attention recommended for test coverage gaps if they become concerns in later WPs.

WP-001 PASS — all 7 acceptance criteria confirmed by code review. Three non-blocking observations recorded in pipeline comments (dead ERROR_CACHE_FILE_CORRUPT constant, catch variable binding style, missing @throws on invalidateMethod). No blocking issues.
Downstream WPs (WP-002+) can safely depend on APICacheException and the hardened APICacheManager/CacheableAPIMethodTrait as a stable foundation.
